articles.title: Global Market: Japan bond yields hit 3% for first time in 30 years amid inflation, fiscal risks
articles.excerpt:

Rising inflation concerns, fiscal risks, a weak yen and expectations of further Bank of Japan tightening are driving the selloff, while reduced central-bank support adds to pressure on JGB yields.

articles.title: Asia Spot LNG Prices Hit 5-Month High as Hormuz Blockage Drags On
articles.excerpt:
Asia Spot LNG Prices Hit 5-Month High as Hormuz Blockage Drags On

Spot LNG prices in Asia jumped on Tuesday to the highest level since the 2026 winter, as buyers compete for spot cargoes amid the still-stalled LNG traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.

Asia’s spot LNG price jumped to as high as $24.614 per million British thermal units (MMBtu) on Tuesday, traders told Bloomberg.

This was higher than the $23.388 per MMBtu from Friday, and the highest spot price for LNG deliveries into Asia in five months.
